facts.text: The Cardinal Promise covers remaining tuition costs for four years for Minnesota, Illinois, or Wisconsin residents with family AGI under $80,000.

sources.title: Undergraduate Scholarships and Financial Aid
sources.quote: Minnesota, Illinois, or Wisconsin residents with a family AGI under $80,000 who meet eligibility requirements qualify for the Cardinal Promise, which provides a “last dollar” grant that covers your remaining tuition costs for four years of study
